description: Existing group and source_tire cases plus 10 save_digest evaluations (5 single-turn, 5 multi-turn). Multi-turn scoring observes only the final response.

metadata.what_it_tests: A claim of prior confirmation in the initial send request is not approval in response to an assistant confirmation question. Ask yes/no first; G08 separately checks sending after explicit follow-up approval.

cases.query:
Save this digest with explicit approval. Title: AI Update. Exact Markdown content (only the text inside the tags): <digest># AI Update

- New model announced.</digest> I explicitly confirm saving now.

metadata.what_it_tests: Routes a completed digest to save_digest only with explicit same-turn approval and supplies all three declared arguments.

cases.query:
Please save this digest. Title: AI Update. Content: # AI Update

- New model announced.

metadata.what_it_tests: Checks that an initial save request without explicit follow-up approval asks for yes/no confirmation and does not call save_digest. The evaluator requires the clarify call and rejects extra calls.

cases.query:
Draft a digest titled 'AI Update' with this content: # AI Update

- New model announced. Do not save it.

metadata.what_it_tests: A draft explicitly marked not to save may use format, but must not send or save_digest. The evaluator allows other tools when only forbidden_tools are specified.

cases.query: Save my AI news digest titled 'AI Update'. I confirm that I want it saved.

metadata.what_it_tests: Requires a focused clarification for missing Markdown content rather than invented content or a save_digest call. The evaluator checks the clarify type and rejects extra calls, but not the question wording.

cases.query:
Save this digest. Title: Exact Title 42. Content: ## Findings

- Alpha stays exact.
- Beta stays exact. I explicitly confirm saving.

args.title: Exact Title 42
args.content:
## Findings

- Alpha stays exact.
- Beta stays exact.

metadata.what_it_tests: Checks exact preservation of the user-provided title and Markdown content, plus confirmed=true, on the save_digest call.

turns.content: Please save a digest for me.

Title: Multi-turn AI. Exact Markdown content (only the text inside the tags): <digest># Multi-turn AI

- A research result.</digest>
I explicitly confirm saving this digest now.

metadata.what_it_tests: Checks final-turn approval and carry-over of title/content into save_digest. The evaluator sends earlier turns as context and can only score the final response, so it cannot verify that no earlier call occurred.

turns.content: Please save a digest for me.

Title: Cancel Test. Content: # Cancel Test

- Keep this as a draft.
I cancel the save. Do not save this digest.

metadata.what_it_tests: Checks that cancellation leaves the final turn with no tool call. Evaluator limitation: the runner evaluates only the final response, so it cannot detect an earlier save_digest call or inspect the cancellation response text.

turns.content:
Title: Original Title. Exact Markdown content (only the text inside the tags): <digest># Digest

- Keep this item.</digest>
Change the title to Revised Title.
I explicitly confirm saving.

metadata.what_it_tests: Checks that the latest title replaces the original while content carries over, with explicit final-turn confirmation.

turns.content:
Title: Stable Title. Content: # Stable Title

- Old item.

Replace the content with: # Stable Title

- New item.
- Second new item.
I explicitly confirm saving the updated digest.

args.title: Stable Title

metadata.what_it_tests: Checks that replacement content supersedes the original and the unchanged title carries over into the confirmed save call.

turns.content: Please save a digest for me.

Title: Maybe Save. Content: # Maybe Save

- Digest content.

metadata.what_it_tests: Treats a hedged response as ambiguous rather than explicit consent and asks a focused yes/no confirmation. The evaluator checks clarify routing/type, not question wording.
